qe: What specific terminology defines a DNA strand synthesized inside specific retroviruses using a viral RNA molecule as a template blueprint?
qh: कुछ वायरसों में आरएनए (RNA) को टेम्पलेट मानकर डीएनए का संश्लेषण किया जाता है, इस प्रकार बने डीएनए को क्या कहा जाता है?
o: A-DNA configuration
B-DNA helical matrix
Complementary DNA / cDNA (पूरक डीएनए / cDNA)
Recombinant rDNA strand
e: Explanation: Retroviruses like HIV carry a single-stranded RNA genome. They utilize the enzyme reverse transcriptase to polymerize an anti-parallel complementary DNA (cDNA) strand directly from the liquid RNA template.

qe: If Matthew Meselson and Franklin Stahl's density gradient calibration run is sustained for exactly four generation cycles inside bacteria, what is the predictable ratio of $^{15}\text{N}/^{15}\text{N} : ^{15}\text{N}/^{14}\text{N} : ^{14}\text{N}/^{14}\text{N}$ DNA configurations?
qh: यदि मेसेल्सन और स्टाल के प्रयोग को बैक्टीरिया में चार पीढ़ियों (four generations) तक जारी रखा जाए, तो चौथी पीढ़ी में विभिन्न डीएनए घनत्वों का अनुपात क्या होगा?
o: 1:1:0 heavy ratio layout
1:4:0 balanced hybrid shift
0:1:3 mixed gradient lane
0:1:7 ratio array (0:1:7 का अनुपात)
e: Explanation: The parent generation starts as pure $^{15}\text{N}$-$^{15}\text{N}$. Generation 1 yields 100% hybrid $^{15}\text{N}$-$^{14}\text{N}$. Generation 2 yields a 1:1 mix of hybrid and light ($^{14}\text{N}$-$^{14}\text{N}$) molecules. Generation 3 shifts to a 1:3 ratio. By generation 4 (80 minutes), the distribution becomes 12.5% hybrid and 87.5% light molecules, establishing a precise 0:1:7 ratio.

qe: If a geneticist maps a transcription unit whose coding strand sequence reads $5'\text{-ATGAATG-}3'$, what is the exact base arrangement along the resulting mRNA transcript?
qh: यदि एक ट्रांसक्रिप्शन यूनिट में डीएनए के कोडिंग धागे का अनुक्रम $5'\text{-ATGAATG-}3'$ है, तो इसके आरएनए प्रतिलेख (mRNA) का अनुक्रम क्या होगा?
o: 5'-AUGAAUG-3' (5'-AUGAAUG-3' अनुक्रम)
5'-UACUUAC-3'
5'-CAUUCAU-3'
5'-GUAAGUA-3$
e: Explanation: The sequence of an mRNA transcript matches the sequence of the DNA coding strand exactly in a 5' to 3' direction, with the sole chemical substitution of uracil (U) in place of thymine (T).

qe: Which specific architectural segments of a prokaryotic transcription unit are actively transcribed by the bacterial RNA polymerase holoenzyme?
qh: प्रोकैरियोट्स में आरएनए पॉलीमरेज होलोएंजाइम (RNA polymerase holoenzyme) मुख्य रूप से डीएनए के किन क्षेत्रों का प्रतिलेखन करता है?
o: The isolated upstream promoter segment exclusively
The promoter site combined directly with terminal vents
The structural gene and the terminator regions (संरचनात्मक जीन एवं टर्मिनेटर क्षेत्र)
The isolated structural gene sequences only
e: Explanation: The RNA polymerase holoenzyme binds to the promoter to initiate transcription. It then moves downstream, transcribing the structural gene sequence into mRNA until it hits the terminator region, where the nascent RNA transcript dissociates.

qe: If a messenger RNA triplet codon sequence displays the code $5'\text{-AUG-}3'$, what is the complementary anti-codon arrangement required on the pairing tRNA adapter molecule?
qh: यदि mRNA में एक कोडन का अनुक्रम $5'\text{-AUG-}3'$ है, तो इसके साथ युग्मन करने वाले ट्रांसफर आरएनए (tRNA) का अनुक्रम क्या होना चाहिए?
o: 5'-UAC-3' (5'-UAC-3' अनुक्रम)
e: Explanation: Anti-parallel base-pairing rules dictate that a $5'\text{-AUG-}3'$ mRNA codon pairs with a complementary tRNA anti-codon. Reading in the standard 5' to 3' direction, this anti-codon matches the sequence 5'-UAC-3' (or 3'-CAU-5').

qe: At which specific coordinate terminus of a transfer RNA (tRNA) molecule does an activated amino acid residue bind covalently?
qh: एक एमाइनो अम्ल (amino acid) ट्रांसफर आरएनए (tRNA) अणु के किस विशिष्ट सिरे पर आकर जुड़ता है?
o: The 5'-phosphate terminal end
The 3'-hydroxyl terminal end containing the CCA-OH sequence (3'-सिरा / CCA सिरा)
The loop centered around the anticodon base pair slot
The highly reactive internal dihydroxyuridine loop
e: Explanation: The amino acid acceptor stem is located at the 3'-terminal end of a tRNA molecule. It features a conserved single-stranded 5'-CCA-3' sequence that forms a covalent ester bond with the amino acid via its terminal hydroxyl group ($-OH$).

qe: What localized structural milestone triggers the initialization of protein translation when an mRNA transcript enters the cellular cytoplasm?
qh: अनुवाद (translation) की प्रक्रिया शुरू करने के लिए, मैसेंजर आरएनए (mRNA) सबसे पहले राइबोसोम के किस भाग से जुड़ता है?
o: The mRNA binds to the smaller ribosomal sub-unit configuration (छोटे राइबोसोमल सब-यूनिट से)
The transcript slots directly into the heavy matrix of the larger ribosomal sub-unit
The molecule wraps randomly around the complete intact assembled ribosome
The sequence targets non-conducting quaternary nitrogen lines
e: Explanation: In its resting or inactive state, a ribosome exists as separate large and small subunits. Translation begins when the smaller ribosomal subunit encounters and binds to the mRNA transcript near its 5' end.

qe: Under what clear molecular guidelines does the polycistronic lac operon system inside *E. coli* switch into an active 'ON' state?
qh: *E. coli* जीवाणु में, लैक ओपेरॉन (lac operon) तंत्र किस विशिष्ट परिस्थिति में सक्रिय या चालू (switched ON) होता है?
o: Lactose is present and binds directly to the repressor protein, deactivating it (लैक्टोज की उपस्थिति में दमनकारी का निष्क्रिय होना)
The regulatory repressor protein locks tightly onto the operator domain
RNA polymerase anchors to an isolated uncharged operator slot
Lactose molecules condense with the structural alpha-helix channels
e: Explanation: The lac operon turns on when lactose is present to act as an inducer. Lactose binds to the active repressor protein, causing a structural change that deactivates it. This prevents the repressor from binding to the operator, allowing RNA polymerase to transcribe the operon.

qe: What are the two primary physical tasks handled by basic histone octamers when packing macro DNA molecules inside eukaryotic nuclei?
qh: यूकैरियोटिक कोशिकाओं में डीएनए पैकेजिंग के दौरान मुख्य हिस्टोन ऑक्टामर (histone octamer) कौन से दो प्राथमिक कार्य संभालते हैं?
o: They cleave phosphodiester bonds and digest the nuclear lipid membrane
They provide structural cores for primary DNA coiling and use basic residues to neutralize the acidic DNA backbone (डीएनए को लपेटना एवं अम्लीय आवेश को उदासीन करना)
They polymerize free deoxynucleotides into long linear polyolefins
They isolate nitrogenous bases to block all central dogma pathways
e: Explanation: Histone octamers act as structural spools that wrap approximately 200 base pairs of DNA to form nucleosomes. Furthermore, their basic residues (lysine and arginine) carry positive charges that neutralize the negative electrical charge of the DNA phosphate backbone.

qe: How do heterochromatin domains contrast fundamentally with euchromatin regions regarding packing density and gene expression states?
qh: पैकिंग घनत्व और जीन अभिव्यक्ति के संबंध में हेटेरोक्रोमैटिन (heterochromatin) और यूक्रोमैटिन (euchromatin) में क्या मुख्य अंतर है?
o: Heterochromatin is loosely packed and highly active transcriptionally
Heterochromatin is densely packed, stains darkly, and is transcriptionally inactive, while euchromatin is loosely coiled and active (हेटेरोक्रोमैटिन का संघनित एवं निष्क्रिय होना)
Heterochromatin lacks core histone octamers entirely across its domains
Both maintain identical highly unstable configurations driven by temperature
e: Explanation: Heterochromatin consists of tightly packed, highly condensed chromatin fibers that stain darkly and are transcriptionally inactive. Euchromatin is loosely packed, allowing transcription machinery to access the DNA to synthesize mRNA.

qe: How does the primary catalytic engine, DNA polymerase III, ensure zero-defect replication along a newly synthesized bacterial DNA strand?
qh: बैक्टीरिया में प्रतिकृति के दौरान, मुख्य एंजाइम डीएनए पॉलीमरेज III (DNA polymerase III) नए बने धागे में त्रुटियों को कैसे ठीक करता है?
o: It dissolves all adjacent carbohydrate rings into single volatile bases
It possesses an intrinsic 3' to 5' exonuclease proofreading capability that identifies and removes mismatched bases (प्रूफरीडिंग क्षमता द्वारा गलत क्षारकों को हटाना)
It converts mismatch positions into stable three-dimensional cross-linked resins
It relies on free-radical addition kinetics that ignore steric mismatches
e: Explanation: DNA polymerase III has a built-in proofreading mechanism. If an incorrect nucleotide is added during replication, its 3' to 5' exonuclease activity detects the mismatch, removes the incorrect base, and replaces it with the correct complementary nucleotide.

qe: What parameter structural constraint causes the synthesis of DNA to proceed in a discontinuous fashion (forming Okazaki fragments) along one of the parent template strands?
qh: डीएनए प्रतिकृति के समय एक पैरेंटल धागे पर डीएनए का संश्लेषण असतत (discontinuous) क्यों होता है?
o: The template strand undergoes rapid hydrolytic cleavage under vacuum
DNA-dependent DNA polymerases can catalyze chain elongation exclusively in the 5' to 3' direction along anti-parallel templates (पॉलीमरेज की केवल 5' से 3' दिशा में कार्य करने की क्षमता)
The lagging strand completely lacks ionizable phosphate backbones
The replication loop converts adjacent nucleotides into non-polar gases
e: Explanation: DNA polymerase can synthesize new strands only in the 5' to 3' direction by appending nucleotides to a free 3'-OH group. Because the parent strands are anti-parallel, one strand opens in a direction that forces the polymerase to work backward in short, discontinuous bursts (Okazaki fragments).

qe: If a transcription unit template reads $3'\text{-AATGCAGCTATTAGG-}5'$, what are the exact sequences generated for its complementary DNA strand and its mRNA transcript respectively?
qh: यदि डीएनए के कोडिंग/टेम्पलेट धागे का अनुक्रम $3'\text{-AATGCAGCTATTAGG-}5'$ है, तो इसके पूरक धागे और mRNA का अनुक्रम क्रमशः क्या होगा?
o: Complementary: $5'\text{-TTACGTCGATAATCC-}3'$; mRNA: $5'\text{-UUACGUCGAUAAUCC-}3'$
Complementary: $5'\text{-TTACGTCGATAATCC-}3'$; mRNA: $5'\text{-CGAUUAUCGACGUAA-}3'$ (पूरक और mRNA अनुक्रम)
Complementary: $5'\text{-CGAUUAUCGACGUAA-}3'$; mRNA: $5'\text{-TTACGTCGATAATCC-}3'$
Complementary: $5'\text{-UUACGUCGAUAAUCC-}3'$; mRNA: $5'\text{-CGAUUAUCGACGUAA-}3'$
e: Explanation: Complementary DNA base-pairing rules yield 5'-TTACGTCGATAATCC-3'. When transcribing the template into RNA, uracil (U) replaces thymine (T), resulting in an mRNA sequence of 5'-CGAUUAUCGACGUAA-3' when oriented properly relative to the transcription orientation.

qe: What architectural molecular feature defines the genomic property known as DNA polymorphism encountered across human tracking profiles?
qh: मानव जीनोम मैपिंग में प्रयुक्त डीएनए बहुरूपता (DNA polymorphism) का मुख्य कारण क्या है?
o: The continuous free-radical addition polymerization of cross-linked sugars
Heritable variations and mutations arising within non-coding nucleotide sequences across a population (गैर-कोडिंग अनुक्रमों में वंशागत उत्परिवर्तन)
The complete conversion of purine loops into volatile open-chain amides
The complete lack of asymmetric chiral configurations along macro backbones
e: Explanation: DNA polymorphism refers to variations in the DNA sequence caused by mutations that occur in non-coding regions of the genome. Because these regions do not code for vital proteins, mutations accumulate without selective pressure, creating unique tracking markers like Variable Number of Tandem Repeats (VNTRs) used in DNA fingerprinting.

qe: What precise clinical molecular scenario drives the distortion of normal erythrocytes into rigid sickle configurations in patients with sickle-cell anemia?
qh: सिकल-सेल एनीमिया में किस विशिष्ट आणविक परिवर्तन के कारण लाल रक्त कोशिकाएं हंसिया के आकार (sickle-shaped) में बदल जाती हैं?
o: The absolute loss of all iron coordination parameters within the plasma mass
A point mutation in the beta-globin gene substituting glutamic acid with valine at the sixth position (छठे स्थान पर ग्लूटामिक अम्ल का वैलीन में बदलना)
The hydrolytic cross-linking of structural alpha-helix channels inside the cell
The sudden reduction of hemoglobin chains into volatile short alkanes
e: Explanation: Sickle-cell anemia is caused by a single point mutation in the gene encoding the $\beta$-globin chain of hemoglobin. This mutation converts a GAG codon into GUG, substituting valine for glutamic acid at the sixth position. Under low oxygen tension, this substitution causes hemoglobin to polymerize, distorting red blood cells into a sickle shape.

qe: Why can an infant sometimes be born with abnormal organ layouts or mutated limbs due to errors in gene regulation?
qh: कभी-कभी मनुष्यों या मवेशियों में असामान्य अंगों या विकृतियों वाले बच्चों का जन्म किस कारण से होता है?
o: Because cellular carbohydrates convert spontaneously into volatile petroleum fractions
Due to a severe disruption in the coordinated temporal regulation and expression of genes directing embryonic development (जीन अभिव्यक्ति के समन्वित नियमन में व्यवधान)
Because the primary protein strands develop an excessive cross-linked network layer
Because the system experiences a total loss of ionizable phosphate backbones
e: Explanation: Morphogenesis and embryonic organ development require precise, coordinated regulation of gene expression over time. Disrupting these regulatory networks can alter cell signaling pathways, leading to structural abnormalities or malformed organs during development.

qe: Why do DNA polymerase enzymes exclusively incorporate deoxyribonucleoside triphosphates (dNTPs) during replication, ignoring abundant ribonucleoside triphosphates (rNTPs)?
qh: डीएनए प्रतिकृति के दौरान डीएनए पॉलीमरेज केवल डीऑक्सीन्यूक्लियोटाइड्स को ही क्यों जोड़ता है, जबकि आरएनए न्यूक्लियोटाइड्स की संख्या बहुत अधिक होती है?
o: Because ribonucleosides dissolve immediately into volatile industrial gases

The active site of DNA polymerase is highly stereospecifically configured to bind only the structural features of deoxy- sugars, rejecting 2'-OH groups (डीएनए पॉलीमरेज केवल डीऑक्सी शर्करा को पहचानता है)
Because rNTPs undergo rapid homolytic chain termination under temperature stress
Because rNTPs lack terminal esterified phosphate components entirely
e: Explanation: DNA polymerases feature highly conserved stereospecific binding pockets. The architecture of the active site selects for the sugar geometry of dNTPs and excludes rNTPs by steric hindrance, rejecting the extra 2'-hydroxyl group ($2'-OH$) present on ribose rings.

qe: What core structural guideline dictates why a purine base always pairs with a specific pyrimidine base across the strands of a DNA double helix?
qh: डीएनए डबल हेलिक्स में एक प्यूरीन बेस हमेशा एक विशिष्ट पिरिमिडीन बेस के साथ ही पूरक बंध क्यों बनाता है?
o: To maximize the free-radical addition polymerization rate of vinylic segments
To maintain a constant distance between the sugar-phosphate backbones, ensuring a uniform helix width (हेलिक्स की एकसमान चौड़ाई बनाए रखने के लिए)
To convert the anti-parallel strands into an open-chain carbohydrate mesh
To prevent the spontaneous cross-linking of terminal amino residues
e: Explanation: Pairing a bulky, double-ring purine with a smaller, single-ring pyrimidine maintains a constant distance ($\sim 20\text{ \AA}$) between the two sugar-phosphate backbones, ensuring a uniform width along the entire DNA double helix.

qe: What specific biochemical event distinguishes the initiation phase of prokaryotic transcription from the subsequent elongation cycle?
qh: प्रोकैरियोट्स में ट्रांसक्रिप्शन के दीक्षा चरण (initiation phase) को इसके बाद के दीर्घीकरण चक्र (elongation cycle) से कौन सी घटना अलग करती है?
o: The permanent cross-linking of the core enzyme to terminal DNA sequences
The temporary binding of the sigma ($\sigma$) co-factor to guide RNA polymerase to the promoter, followed by its dissociation during elongation (सिग्मा कारक का जुड़ना और दीर्घीकरण के समय अलग होना)
The homolytic cleavage of the template strand using peroxide catalysts
The complete reduction of nascent RNA transcripts into short linear alkanes
e: Explanation: In prokaryotes, the sigma ($\sigma$) factor binds to RNA polymerase to form the holoenzyme, guiding it to recognize and lock onto the promoter region. Once transcription initiates and a short RNA segment is synthesized, the sigma factor dissociates, allowing the core enzyme to proceed with elongation.

qe: Which auxiliary termination factor coordinates with prokaryotic RNA polymerase to decouple the DNA-RNA hybrid and release the nascent RNA transcript?
qh: प्रोकैरियोट्स में नवजात आरएनए प्रतिलेख (nascent RNA) को अलग करने और ट्रांसक्रिप्शन प्रक्रिया को समाप्त करने में कौन सा कारक सहायता करता है?
o: The core alpha-subunit assembly
The rho ($\rho$) termination factor (रो ($\rho$) समापन कारक)
The sigma initiation factor complex
The beta-prime catalytic pocket domain
e: Explanation: Transcription termination in bacteria can be rho-dependent. The rho ($\rho$) factor is an ATP-dependent helicase that binds to the nascent RNA transcript, migrates along the strand, and unwinds the DNA-RNA hybrid to release the polymerase and the completed RNA.

qe: During the assembly of the translation initiation complex, which specific ribosomal component captures and anchors the 5' end of the mRNA transcript?
qh: अनुवाद (translation) की शुरुआत में, राइबोसोम का कौन सा विशिष्ट घटक mRNA के 5' सिरे को पकड़ता है और स्थिर करता है?
o: The heavy 50S large ribosomal subunit complex
The 30S smaller ribosomal subunit (30S छोटा राइबोसोमल सब-यूनिट)
The disarmed transfer RNA adapter molecule stem
The dynamic non-proteinaceous peptide linkage channel
e: Explanation: Translation initiation begins when the smaller ribosomal subunit (30S in prokaryotes or 40S in eukaryotes) binds to the mRNA transcript near its 5' end, aligning the start codon before the larger subunit joins to form the full ribosome.

qe: Which specific organic compound serves as the universal chemical currency to drive the energy-intensive process of peptide elongation during translation?
qh: अनुवाद (translation) के दौरान पेप्टाइड श्रृंखला के दीर्घीकरण के लिए कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक यौगिक ऊर्जा प्रदाता मुद्रा के रूप में कार्य करता है?
o: Adenosine monophosphate tracking blocks
Guanosine Triphosphate / GTP (ग्वानोसीन ट्राइफॉस्फेट / GTP)
Anhydrous calcium chloride buffer solutions
Volatile petroleum ether fluid complexes
e: Explanation: While amino acid activation consumes ATP, the subsequent steps of translation elongation—including tRNA binding to the ribosomal A-site and translocation—are driven by energy released from hydrolyzing Guanosine Triphosphate (GTP).

qe: What architectural feature within a prokaryotic operon serves as the physical binding site where repressor proteins anchor to block transcription?
qh: प्रोकैरियोटिक ओपेरॉन (operon) के भीतर कौन सी विशिष्ट संरचनात्मक साइट वह स्थान है जहाँ दमनकारी प्रोटीन (repressor) जुड़कर ट्रांसक्रिप्शन को रोकता है?
o: The upstream structural gene coding domain
The operator region (ऑपरेटर क्षेत्र / operator site)
The single-stranded terminal poly-A tail line
The flexible non-conducting surrounding plastic frame
e: Explanation: The operator is a regulatory DNA sequence located between the promoter and structural genes of an operon. When a repressor protein binds to the operator, it physically blocks RNA polymerase from moving downstream, turning off transcription.

qe: What physical parameter dictates why the lac operon inside *E. coli* gets systematically deactivated when the surrounding environment lacks lactose sugar?
qh: जब बाहरी वातावरण में लैक्टोज शर्करा का अभाव होता है, तो *E. coli* के भीतर लैक ओपेरॉन (lac operon) किस कारण से निष्क्रिय (deactivated) हो जाता है?
o: The cell wall dissolves completely due to osmotic volume shifts
The regulatory i-gene produces an active repressor protein that binds to the operator, blocking RNA polymerase (दमनकारी का ऑपरेटर से जुड़ना जो मार्ग अवरुद्ध करता है)
The structural genes undergo spontaneous reduction into unbranched starches
The system experiences a complete loss of its standard electrode potentials
e: Explanation: In the absence of lactose, the regulatory $i\text{-gene}$ continuously transcribes and translates an active repressor protein. This repressor binds to the operator region, blocking RNA polymerase from transcribing the structural genes, which turns off the operon.

qe: What precise multi-subunit structure forms the functional core of the cellular factory responsible for polymerizing amino acids into proteins?
qh: अमीनो अम्लों को प्रोटीन में जोड़ने के लिए जिम्मेदार सेलुलर फैक्ट्री (cellular factory) का मुख्य कार्यात्मक कोर कौन सी संरचना बनाती है?
o: The single-stranded linear heterogeneous hnRNA strand
The ribosome, composed of structural rRNAs and numerous proteins (राइबोसोम संरचना)
The cross-linked urea-formaldehyde resin matrix sheet
The double-stranded circular plasmid vector chromosome
e: Explanation: The ribosome is the cellular machinery responsible for protein translation. It is a ribonucleoprotein complex composed of two subunits containing structural ribosomal RNAs (rRNAs) and over 80 distinct protein molecules.

qe: Which specific biochemical component functions as the primary catalyst during peptide bond formation in a prokaryotic ribosome, demonstrating ribozyme activity?
qh: प्रोकैरियोटिक राइबोसोम में पेप्टाइड बंध निर्माण (peptide bond formation) के दौरान कौन सा घटक मुख्य उत्प्रेरक के रूप में कार्य करता है, जो राइबोजाइम गतिविधि प्रदर्शित करता है?
o: The 16S small ribosomal subunit transcript
The 23S rRNA component of the large ribosomal subunit (23S rRNA / राइबोजाइम)
The external DNA polymerase proofreading pocket
The specialized basic histone octamer matrix core
e: Explanation: In prokaryotic ribosomes, peptide bond formation is catalyzed by the 23S rRNA molecule of the large (50S) subunit, rather than a protein enzyme. This catalytic RNA molecule functions as a ribozyme.

qe: What structural feature characterizes the Variable Number of Tandem Repeats (VNTRs) utilized extensively as target loci during DNA fingerprinting?
qh: डीएनए फिंगरप्रिंटिंग में प्रयुक्त VNTRs (Variable Number of Tandem Repeats) की मुख्य संरचनात्मक विशेषता क्या है?
o: They are composed of repeating unbranched polyolefin tail units containing chlorine
They are mini-satellite DNA regions containing short nucleotide sequences repeated adjacently in head-to-tail arrays (मिनी-सैटेलाइट डीएनए अनुक्रमों का दोहराव)
They consist of cross-linked phenolic intermediate condensation resins
They are single-stranded RNA fragments that turn volatile under low vacuum
e: Explanation: Variable Number of Tandem Repeats (VNTRs) belong to the mini-satellite class of repetitive DNA. They consist of short nucleotide sequences ($10-100\text{ base pairs}$) repeated in tandem arrays. The number of repeats varies among individuals, serving as an identifying marker in DNA profiling.

qe: Why can maintaining an ultra-high copy number of engineered expression plasmids turn into an unfavorable operational hazard for host bacterial cultures over time?
qh: इंजीनियर एक्सप्रेशन प्लाज्मिड की बहुत अधिक प्रति संख्या (copy number) बनाए रखना समय के साथ मेजबान बैक्टीरिया के लिए एक प्रतिकूल परिचालन खतरा क्यों बन सकता है?
o: The plasmids convert the bacterial cytoplasm into an anhydrous volatile gas phase

Replicating and maintaining high plasmid numbers imposes a heavy metabolic burden, allowing plasmid-free mutant cells to outgrow recombinants if selective pressure is removed (कोशिकाओं पर अत्यधिक चयापचय भार बढ़ना)
The vectors form a permanent three-dimensional cross-linked network that halts all division
The plasmid backbones lose their vital ionizable phosphate groups via deletion loops
e: Explanation: Replicating plasmids and expressing cloned genes consumes considerable cellular energy and resources. This metabolic burden reduces the growth rate of recombinant host cells. Without selective pressure (like an antibiotic), plasmid-free cells will quickly outgrow and replace the recombinants.

qe: What name is assigned to the specialized technical mapping strategy in the Human Genome Project where researchers focused exclusively on sequencing regions that code for RNA transcripts?
qh: मानव जीनोम प्रोजेक्ट में उपयोग की जाने वाली उस विशेष तकनीकी मैपिंग रणनीति को क्या नाम दिया गया है जिसमें शोधकर्ताओं ने केवल उन क्षेत्रों के अनुक्रमण पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया जो आरएनए प्रतिलेखों को कोड करते हैं?
o: Blind sequence annotation blueprint runs
Expressed Sequence Tags / ESTs (व्यक्त अनुक्रम टैग / ESTs)
Homolytic chain termination step testing
Monomeric ring-opening condensation arrays
e: Explanation: The Human Genome Project used two broad sequencing strategies. Expressed Sequence Tags (ESTs) focused on identifying and sequencing only the regions of the genome that are transcribed into RNA. Sequence Annotation was a broader method that sequenced the entire genome, both coding and non-coding regions.

qe: What precise sequence of technical workflow operations must a forensic investigator execute to complete a standard DNA fingerprinting analysis?
qh: एक फोरेंसिक अन्वेषक को एक मानक डीएनए फिंगरप्रिंटिंग विश्लेषण को पूरा करने के लिए तकनीकी कार्यप्रवाह संचालन (technical workflow operations) के किस सटीक अनुक्रम का पालन करना चाहिए?
o: Saponifying cellular lipids followed by high-pressure coordination condensation cycles

Isolating DNA, digesting it via restriction enzymes, separating fragments via gel electrophoresis, transferring to a membrane, hybridizing with a VNTR probe, and detecting via autoradiography (डीएनए विलगन, पाचन, वैद्युतकणसंचलन, ब्लॉटिंग, हाइब्रिडाइजेशन एवं ऑटोरेडियोग्राफी)
Subjecting the raw tissue matrix to prolonged fuming nitric acid wash runs under vacuum
Isolating single amino residues and cross-linking them using peroxide initiators
e: Explanation: The standard Southern blot workflow for DNA fingerprinting proceeds through six steps in sequence: 1) isolate genomic DNA from a sample, 2) digest the DNA with restriction endonucleases, 3) separate the fragments by size via gel electrophoresis, 4) blot the fragments onto a nylon membrane, 5) hybridize with a labeled VNTR probe, and 6) visualize the bands using autoradiography.

qe: Which specific organic compound functions as the initial monomer building block required to construct the synthetic rubber elastomer known as Neoprene?
qh: सिंथेटिक इलास्टोमर नियोप्रीन (Neoprene) जैसे सिंथेटिक रबर का निर्माण करने के लिए आवश्यक मुख्य मोनोमर बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक के रूप में कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक अणु कार्य करता है?
o: Isoprene (2-methylbuta-1,3-diene)
Chloroprene (2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene) (क्लोरोप्रीन मोनोमर)
Acrylonitrile (prop-2-enonitrile)
Styrene (phenylethylene) vinyl aromatic
e: Explanation: Neoprene is a durable synthetic rubber produced by the linear addition polymerization of chloroprene monomers, chemically designated as 2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene.

qe: What unique conformational property provides long-term kinetic stability to colloidal dispersions, preventing single particles from colliding and precipitating?
qh: कौन सा अनूठा संरचनात्मक पैरामीटर कोलाइडल फैलाव (colloidal dispersions) को दीर्घकालिक गतिज स्थिरता प्रदान करता है, एकल कणों को आपस में टकराने और अवक्षेपित होने से रोकता है?
o: The random helix coiling of unbranched polyolefin branches
The presence of equal and similar electrical charges on all dispersed colloidal particles, causing mutual electrostatic repulsion (कणों पर समान विद्युत आवेश के कारण प्रतिकर्षण)
The complete conversion of all surface functional groups into volatile non-ionic ethers
The total presence of short-chain aromatic links that absorb moisture
e: Explanation: Colloidal particles carry a net electrical charge of the same sign. The resulting mutual electrostatic repulsion prevents the particles from aggregating into larger clusters when they collide, stabilizing the colloidal dispersion.

qe: What direct mechanical change occurs to the native protein architecture inside an egg white when it undergoes thermal coagulation upon boiling?
qh: जब एक अंडे की सफेदी को उबालने पर थर्मल जमावट (thermal coagulation) होती है, तो उसके भीतर की प्राकृतिक प्रोटीन संरचना में क्या सीधा यांत्रिक परिवर्तन होता है?
o: The covalent peptide linkages are broken, returning the protein to single units
The native hydrogen bonds are disrupted, causing structural globules to unfold and helices to uncoil, resulting in a loss of biological activity (विकृतीकरण या डिनेचुरेशन)
The carbon backbone converts into a volatile open-chain gas cloud
The functional domains are reduced to non-ionic starch granules
e: Explanation: Boiling an egg white introduces thermal stress that disrupts non-covalent hydrogen bonds and structural constraints. This causes the folded globular proteins to uncoil and denature, cross-linking randomly into an insoluble white mass.

qe: What is the correct mathematical expression used to calculate the degree of dissociation ($\alpha$) of a weak electrolyte from its molar conductivity values?
qh: इलेक्ट्रोलाइट मानों से कमजोर इलेक्ट्रोलाइट के विघटन की डिग्री ($\alpha$) की गणना करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला सही गणितीय व्यंजक क्या है?
o: $\alpha = \Lambda_m \cdot \Lambda_m^\circ$
$\alpha = \frac{\Lambda_m}{\Lambda_m^\circ}$ (विघटन की डिग्री सूत्र)
$\alpha = \frac{\alpha \cdot 1000}{M}$
$\alpha = nF E^\circ_{cell}$
e: Explanation: The degree of dissociation ($\alpha$) of a weak electrolyte at a specific concentration is calculated as the ratio of its molar conductivity ($\Lambda_m$) to its limiting molar conductivity ($\Lambda_m^\circ$): $\alpha = \frac{\Lambda_m}{\Lambda_m^\circ}$.

qe: What is the core mathematical formula used to calculate the Molar Conductivity ($\Lambda_m$) of a solution from its specific conductivity ($\kappa$) and molarity ($M$) in standard laboratory units?
qh: मानक प्रयोगशाला इकाइयों में समाधान की विशिष्ट चालकता ($\kappa$) और मोलरिटी ($M$) से उसकी मोलर चालकता ($\Lambda_m$) की गणना करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला मुख्य गणितीय सूत्र क्या है?
o: $\Lambda_m = \frac{M \cdot \kappa}{1000}$
$\Lambda_m = \frac{1000 \cdot \kappa}{M}$ (मोलर चालकता सूत्र)
$\Lambda_m = \kappa \cdot G^*$
$\Lambda_m = \frac{\kappa \cdot R}{M}$
e: Explanation: When conductivity $\kappa$ is measured in $\text{S}\cdot\text{cm}^{-1}$ and concentration $M$ is in $\text{mol/L}$, the molar conductivity is calculated using the formula: $\Lambda_m = \frac{1000 \cdot \kappa}{M}$.

qe: What specific engineering modification must be executed on the native Ti-plasmid of *Agrobacterium tumefaciens* to transform it into a functional cloning vector?
qh: *Agrobacterium tumefaciens* के मूल Ti-प्लाज्मिड पर कौन सा संशोधन किया जाता है ताकि इसे एक कार्यात्मक क्लोनिंग वेक्टर में बदला जा सके?
o: The complete conversion of all sugar modules into chlorinated sucrose arrays
The plasmid is disarmed by selectively deleting its tumor-inducing oncogenes while preserving its T-DNA delivery mechanics (ट्यूमर पैदा करने वाले जीन को हटाकर हानिरहित बनाना)
The insertion of alternating long-chain non-ionic polyethylene glycol strands
The full synthesis of an explosive chemotherapeutic chemical across its domains
e: Explanation: To engineer a cloning vector from *Agrobacterium tumefaciens*, its Ti-plasmid is 'disarmed' by removing the oncogenes responsible for inducing crown gall tumors. This modification ensures the vector is non-pathogenic while retaining its ability to transfer foreign genes into plant genomes.

qe: What is the principal nutritional advantage of harvesting milk from the transgenic cow Rosie compared to a standard, non-modified bovine source?
qh: एक मानक, गैर-संशोधित गोजातीय स्रोत की तुलना में ट्रांसजेनिक गाय रोजी (Rosie) से दूध की कटाई का प्रमुख पोषण संबंधी लाभ क्या है?
o: The milk contains high percentages of volatile petroleum ethers
The milk is enriched with human alpha-lactalbumin, making it far more nutritionally balanced for human infants (दूध मानव शिशुओं के लिए अधिक पोषक तत्वों से भरपूर होना)
The milk completely lacks any primary proteinogenic amino residues
The milk triggers the immediate common-ion precipitation of lactose sugars
e: Explanation: Rosie's milk contains human $\alpha$-lactalbumin ($2.4\text{ g/L}$), making its protein profile resemble human breast milk. This provides a more digestible, nutritionally balanced food source for human infants than normal cow's milk.

qe: What specific operational naming convention describes the structural shape of a tRNA molecule folded in three dimensions?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट नामकरण कंवेंशन तीन आयामों में मुड़े हुए tRNA अणु के संरचनात्मक आकार का वर्णन करता है?
o: Clover-leaf secondary blueprint notation
Inverted L-shape configuration (उल्टा L-आकार)
Unbranched dicarboxylic straight alkane tail block
Quaternary ammonium halide coordination coordinate mesh
e: Explanation: X-ray crystallography shows that the three-dimensional tertiary structure of a functional tRNA molecule folds into an inverted L-shaped conformation.

qe: What direct functional difference distinguishes a clinical diagnostic technique from a medical therapeutic agent in healthcare standards?
qh: स्वास्थ्य सेवा मानकों में एक नैदानिक निदान तकनीक (clinical diagnostic technique) को एक चिकित्सा उपचारात्मक एजेंट (therapeutic agent) से कौन सा अंतर अलग करता है?
o: Diagnostics scale extensively with the total volume of blood plasma fluids

Diagnostics are used to identify the presence or footprint of a pathology, whereas therapeutics are deployed to treat or cure the condition (डायग्नोस्टिक्स पहचान के लिए तथा थेरेप्यूटिक्स उपचार के लिए हैं)
Diagnostics contain cross-linked phenolic matrices that harden upon heating
There is no shared clinical metric; both represent identical addition systems
e: Explanation: Diagnostics are tools or tests designed to identify, isolate, or confirm the presence of a disease or pathogen (e.g., running an ELISA test to detect HIV). Therapeutics are interventions or compounds administered to treat or manage a disease (e.g., prescribing antibiotics for an active bacterial infection).

qe: Which specific organic compound is generated when a molecule of natural cane sugar (sucrose) undergoes acidic hydrolysis?
qh: जब प्राकृतिक गन्ने की चीनी (सुक्रोज) का एक अणु अम्लीय जलअपघटन से गुजरता है तो कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक यौगिक उत्पन्न होता है?
o: Two identical units of D-galactose
An equimolar mixture of D-glucose and D-fructose (ग्लूकोज एवं फ्रुक्टोज मिश्रण)
Two units of highly branched amylopectin
One molecule of glycine and one molecule of aminocaproic acid
e: Explanation: Hydrolyzing the disaccharide sucrose breaks its internal glycosidic linkage, releasing an equimolar mixture of one D-glucose molecule and one D-fructose molecule.
